<!-- Fixture text for testing the site. It is not a page of the wiki and never ships. -->

A bear front crowds the middle of the line, so the answer starts with where the extra defenders
cannot reach.

## Run the ball outside

Coach Example Three moves the point of attack to the edge, where the front has the fewest
defenders.

## Pass first

Coach Example Four starts with the pass to make the defense widen before running inside.
